name: Building Plans
heroSubtitle: Precision architectural floor plans, spatial zoning layouts, elevations, and technical building drawings.
shortDescription: Architectural layouts, technical building drawings, floor plans, elevations, and professional building plan design services.
fullDescription: TOP TECH brings precision spatial planning to residential, commercial, and mixed-use projects. We produce clear, well-proportioned architectural floor plans, site layouts, elevations, and presentation-ready building drawings designed for functional living, efficient workflow, and smooth engineering coordination.

benefits.title: Efficient Space Utilization
benefits.description: Thoughtful room proportions, natural light orientation, and logical circulation prevent wasted square footage.

benefits.title: Clear Builder Communication
benefits.description: Accurate dimension lines, annotations, and clean elevation sheets minimize confusion on site.

benefits.title: Tailored to Plot & Budget
benefits.description: Layouts are planned around your exact land dimensions, orientation, and functional room requirements.

features.title: Dimensioned Floor Plans
features.description: Detailed room-by-room layouts with wall thicknesses, door swings, window placement, and furniture zoning.

features.title: Exterior Elevations
features.description: Front, rear, and side facade drawings illustrating roof lines, openings, and material proportions.

features.title: Site & Parking Planning
features.description: Coordinated setback awareness, driveway access, walkways, and outdoor utility zones.

features.title: CAD & Print-Ready Sheets
features.description: Clean DWG/CAD files alongside scaled PDF sheets ready for A1/A3 plotting.

processSteps.title: Plot Details & Program Brief
processSteps.description: We review your land dimensions, room list, story count, and architectural style preferences.

processSteps.title: Preliminary Floor Plan Concept
processSteps.description: We draft initial spatial zoning and room flow options for your feedback.

processSteps.title: Detailed Drafting & Elevations
processSteps.description: We refine exact dimensions, openings, stairs, and exterior elevation views.

processSteps.title: Final Drawing Package Delivery
processSteps.description: You receive scaled PDF drawing sheets and editable CAD files for project coordination.

faqs.question: What information do you need to start designing a building plan?
faqs.answer: Share your plot dimensions (or survey sketch), desired number of rooms/floors, intended use (residential, commercial, or mixed-use), and any reference styles you like.

faqs.question: Can plans be customized for irregular or compact plots?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every floor plan is drafted specifically to fit your plot boundaries, access road, and daylight orientation.

faqs.question: In what formats are final building drawings delivered?
faqs.answer: Final drawing sets are delivered as scaled, high-resolution PDF sheets ready for printing alongside CAD source files where agreed.

idealFor: Property owners, developers, and contractors needing clear, practical architectural drawings.
